import openpyxl
from collections import defaultdict

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('tasks/3-59/testbed/data/score.xlsx')

# Skip header

print('Total records:', len(students))

# Compute per-student stats (aggregate by name)
student_scores = defaultdict(list)
for name, m1, m2 in students:
    student_scores[name].append((m1, m2))

print('\nPer-student records:')

# Overall stats

m2_scores = [s[2] for s in students]
avg_m1 = sum(m1_scores)/len(m1_scores)

print(f'\nAverage midterm1: {avg_m1:.2f}')
print(f'Average midterm2: {avg_m2:.2f}')
print(f'Min midterm1: {min(m1_scores)}, Max midterm1: {max(m1_scores)}')
print(f'Min midterm2: {min(m2_scores)}, Max midterm2: {max(m2_scores)}')

    avg = sum(all_scores)/len(all_scores)
    print(f'{name}: {avg:.2f}')
